title: Tool chucks (end mill holders) with clamp screws fr flatted cylindrical shank tool, Part 2: Connecting dimensions of chucks and designation
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part I) lays down the dimensions of tool chucks (end mill holders) .with clamp screws designed for driving flatted cylindrical shanks in accordance with IS 8692 and specifies the clamps screws used. It also gives the maximum diameter of the chuck nose. This standard defines two types of drive; a) chucks with bores of c?, > 20 mm intended for driving cylindrical shank tools with a single flat, these tools being provided with either a single or a double cutting part; and b) chucks with bores of rf, < 25 mm intended for driving cylindrical shank tools with a double flat, these tools being provided with a single cutting part only. NOTE — The connecting dimensions of the various types of chucks and the designation of tool chucks (end mill holders) with clamp screws are dealt with in IS 11835 (Part 2).
